## 3.5.1

- **New app icon.** A gold compass spark, drawn for Dota Improviser, replaces the old icon.
- **Send feedback:** Settings now has a button that opens an email with your app version and system filled in. Nothing is sent until you press send.
- **Share card shows the website address,** so a friend who sees your scorecard can find the app.
- **Fixed:** a huge controller icon on the empty Per-match trend chart.
- **Fixed:** Strategize's panel tabs and the ward plan's "place" buttons no longer overflow.
- **Licence:** personal, non-commercial use only; the new licence ships with these installers.

---

## Version history (10 builds)

**1.x**
1. **v0.1.0 – 1.0.0**: first releases: Match Review, draft suggestions and item planning, the Know reference, optional Puter AI, a live overlay and coach.
2. **1.0.1 – 1.0.2**: Draft Vision fixes, the macOS Screen Recording flow, new icon, Windows installer and trust fixes, background tray mode.
3. **1.0.3 – 1.0.4**: achievements revamp, smarter item coaching from your own games, a dedicated Overlay tab with live previews.
4. **1.0.5 – 1.0.6**: Windows overlay z-order fix, idle pop-up windows freed from memory.
5. **1.0.7 – 1.0.9**: resource use scales to free RAM, lighter Draft Vision capture, inline coach tips instead of repeating toasts.

**2.x**
6. **2.0.0 – 2.0.4**: rank-aware benchmarks, Match Review tabs, AI-assisted item analysis, data that no longer lags a patch behind.
7. **2.1.0 – 2.3.2**: launcher-style redesign and overlay v3, support view, separate learning for ranked/Turbo/Single Draft/Ability Draft, hero-aware coaching (HP/mana model, counter traits, fight plan), new Heroes and Draft pages.

**3.x**
8. **3.0.0 – 3.2.1**: Match Review rebuilt (Story, Replay, Build, Events), first-run setup, Windows and macOS performance fixes, choose install folder, move your data, uninstall.
9. **3.3.0 – 3.3.4**: Strategize planning board with rooms (code and PIN), real ward vision, timeline, stock-aware wards, templates, shared view.
10. **3.4.0 – 3.5.1**: replay video mode, support ward intelligence, lane-aware ward map with close-ups, Strategize Board / Match / Video modes with unit compare, jungle and insights, hero notes, translator fixes, own app icon.

Builds before 3.3.0 are not listed on this page.

## 3.5.0

- **Strategize has three modes: Board, Match and Video.** Match plays the same player as Video with no download, from OpenDota's record of the match: kills, team fights, wards, towers and Roshan falling, net worth. OpenDota only knows where heroes died, so between deaths a hero holds its last known spot and is drawn faded. Video is the real replay with every hero moving, now with vision for Radiant, Dire or both teams.
- **Unit panel with the match behind it, in every mode:** click a hero for net worth, GPM, XPM, last hits, kills, deaths and the items bought by that minute, and compare it with any other hero.
- **Jungle tab:** camps on your half of the map, nearest first, with walk time, the minute spawn and the stack window.
- **Insights tab:** map control (replay), net worth lead, heroes alive, Roshan and Tormentor windows.
- **Hero notes:** how Dawnbreaker, Primal Beast, Mars, Marci, Kez, Largo, Ring Master, Hoodwink and Snapfire play, what to watch and the answers; shown on the Heroes page and given to the AI coach.
- **Chat translation:** Filipino lines and other lines the app couldn't place are now translated; one unreadable AI answer no longer loses the whole batch, and lines already in your language are left alone.
- Video controls row tidied.

## 3.4.1

- **Replay playback works again.** Valve now serves replays as Zstandard inside the `.dem.bz2` file, which the app read as bzip2 and refused ("not a bzip2 file"). Both formats are handled, and the replay address falls back to the match record when OpenDota's replay lookup has none.
- **Support ward intelligence.** Your ward spots now learn from your saved replays: how long wards lasted, how often and how fast the enemy found them, which heroes found them, and what each spot's vision was worth (enemy deaths it covered). Spots you keep losing are ranked down with a plain warning and a better nearby cell; sentry spots mark where the enemy keeps warding you.
- **Overlay ward map knows your lane** (from where you stand, else your role), puts your lane's spots first while laning, and shows a zoomed close-up of the exact cell with the real trees, vision and nearest tree distance.
- **Match Review support report** adds: enemy deaths your observers covered, observers that saw nothing, who found your wards and when, and enemy observers nobody found.
- Strategize: floating notice and room chip buttons now click (the notice close button did nothing).
- Dashboard: no per-panel blur, off-screen lists skipped (less lag), new Heroes and Draft layouts.
- Chat translator: better language detection for Indonesian, Spanish and Turkish lines, and tolerant reading of the AI's reply format.

## Watch past matches as they were played (video mode)
- **Strategize → Load match → Replay:** the app downloads that match's replay from Valve when you ask, reads it on your PC and stores a compact copy (about 50 KB per match; the raw replay is never kept).
- **Video mode:** every hero moves exactly as in the match, with wards going up and expiring, kills, fights, towers, Roshan, smokes and buybacks. Play at 0.5×–16×, scrub the timeline, jump between kills and fights, follow a hero, turn on your team's vision, and see health bars during fights.
- **Pause & plan here:** turn any moment into an editable plan step, with heroes and wards exactly where they were.
- **Watch together:** in a room, the host's playback leads and members follow along (each app downloads the replay itself).
- **Watch in Strategize** from Match Review jumps straight in.
- Replays are only for finished matches and never download during your own draft or game. Valve keeps replays for a limited time; when one is gone, the match's OpenDota fight steps stay on the board.
- Matches you've opened before can find their replay even while OpenDota is down.

## Clearer labels
- One status line on the map that never overlaps the timeline, a labelled hero strip (level, net worth, respawn), a legend for every marker, full text on timeline markers, clear replay states (size, progress, saved, unavailable), and reasons on greyed-out buttons.

## Strategize
- **Templates:** one click adds a Smoke gank (top or bottom), a Roshan setup (either pit) or a Defend high ground step, with heroes placed and standard wards. Wards the shop couldn't have sold at that time are left out and named.
- **Timings on the timeline:** bounty, water and power runes, the Tormentor's first spawn and day/night (approximate, as labelled). Bookmark a Roshan or Tormentor kill and its respawn window appears.
- **Range rings:** each spell's cast range for the selected hero (from Valve's hero data) plus Blink Dagger's 1200.
- **What if dewarded:** see what your team stops seeing if an observer gets destroyed.
- **Plan sheet:** a printable page with heroes, every step's time, wards, notes and bookmarks; or copy it as text.

## Rooms
- Everyone in a room can edit by default (the host's lock and hero roles stay optional).
- Each player gets a colour and initials. Cursors, edit flashes, drags and the activity feed use them, and every ward or hero someone placed or moved shows a ring in their colour with their initials (a toggle hides them).
- Each player's step shows on the timeline; members follow the host's timeline until they navigate themselves.
- Fixed: other players' cursors never showed in rooms.

## Look
- The Strategize side panel has even padding and aligned controls on every tab and window size.
- The selected tab, in the top bar and in Strategize, now has a full border instead of a single line.

## Strategize
- **Line up your own map image:** in Map → Your image, click 2–3 landmarks (Ancients, fountains, Roshan, a tier-1 tower) on your picture and it lines up with the map, even for non-square renders with black corners. A see-through preview, wider sliders and arrow-key nudging help fine-tune it.
- **Safer image import:** only PNG and JPEG are accepted; size and dimensions are checked before the picture is opened, and only a re-encoded copy is kept (no metadata, never uploaded or shared).
- **Simple mode:** the new default for first visits shows just the map, the main tools, the timeline, Load match and Room. Switch to Full any time.
- **Bookmarks:** press B to mark any moment, label it, jump back to it. Bookmarks travel with plan codes and sync in rooms.
- **Zoom and precision:** finer zoom that stays anchored on your cursor, zoom out until the whole map fits with room around it, hold Shift to drag slowly, and type or copy exact coordinates.
- **Room roles:** the host can hand heroes to members ("Mira controls Lion"); right-click a hero to swap it, add summons, label it, focus or remove it.
- Undo now clears everything it should, including marks carried into later steps.

## Match Review
- When OpenDota is down or slow, the app stops waiting sooner, shows saved data where it has it, and tells you why instead of spinning.

## Strategize: a real match timeline
- **Timeline bar under the map:** scrub the game clock, with step and fight markers, night bands, and ticks where wards go up and expire. Jump to the previous/next step or fight; faces on the left edge focus each hero.
- **Wards by hand, with game rules:** clicking a ward-plan spot selects it; press Place or drag it onto the map. Placed wards drag anywhere valid. Each team's observer and sentry stock follows the step's clock (max 4 observers, one every 2:15; max 8 sentries, one every 1:10, from Valve's item data; the starting stock is approximate and says so), so overstacking is refused with when the next one arrives.
- **Clear an area:** drag a box to clear wards, arrows and tree cuts (and units if you choose), or clear one kind for the step. **Undo/redo** with Ctrl/⌘+Z, also in rooms.
- **Smoother map:** pan and zoom take about half the work they did, and the painted map gets sharper when you zoom in. The map uses all the space between the tool bar and the panel.
- **Loaded matches:** a kill feed with portraits on each fight, every hero's deaths in the Unit tab, and a per-team summary of wards and deaths.

## Watch live
- Strategize → Board → **Watch live**: pick one of the top live games OpenDota lists, see both lineups, and follow the score and gold lead on the timeline every 30 seconds. Share it with your room.
- Fair play: it's off during your own draft or game, never shows your own match, and always shows Valve's spectator delay. OpenDota sends no hero positions for live games, so none are shown.

## Also in this release (from 3.3.1)
### Review a past match as a team
- **Load match** (Strategize → Board): pick one of your recent games, or paste a match ID, and it becomes a plan: both lineups, a lanes step, and one step per team fight with where each hero died, the wards that were up, and a note with deaths, the gold swing and who killed whom.
- Host a room and load it: everyone steps through the match together and writes "next time" notes on each step. Only death spots and wards are real (OpenDota keeps no hero paths), so playback jumps between steps instead of drawing movement.

### Sturdier rooms
- A dropped joiner reconnects by itself (same code and PIN) for about 30 seconds.
- Rejoining from the same Steam account takes back your seat.
- The host drops players who stop answering, and any board that falls out of step reloads automatically.
- If the host loses the room service, it says so and offers Try again.

### Steps
- The step strip reads left to right: back, steps (scroll sideways), forward, then zoom and + Step.
- Deleting a step keeps you near where you were; names can be cleared and retyped; game times must be m:ss; a step earlier than the one before is flagged.

### Layout
- The map fills the board again (no inner box or bands).
- The side panel's tabs fit at every window size and are split into clear sections; the Room tab is no longer cut off.

## Strategize (new tab)
- Chess-style plan board on Dota's own map: up to 5 heroes a side (or Load draft), summons and illusions, steps you play back at real move speed, observer/sentry wards with real vision, arrows, tree cuts and a measure tool.
- Click a hero for move speed, attack range, day/night vision, abilities, popular items and fixes against the enemy board. Support ward plan learned from your own parsed replays.
- **Rooms:** host a room and plan live with up to 19 teammates (peer to peer; nothing is saved online). Joining needs the room code **and a 4-digit PIN** only the host sees. **Share invite** copies a message with both, ready to paste into Discord or Steam chat; pasting it into Join fills everything in.
- Rooms connect on Windows and macOS, on the same network or across strict firewalls (relay over UDP or TCP when a direct connection isn't possible).
- Optional: use your own map image, saved only on your PC.

## Maps
- Built from Dota's own 7.42 map file: exact trees, lanes, buildings, camps, runes, outposts, Tormentors and both Roshan lairs, with new original icons and legends.
- Map data for future patches can arrive without an app update.

## Match Review
- 5 tabs instead of 7, nothing lost. Recent games listed right on the page.
- Replay: playback, kill feed, and a right rail with the fight card next to the map.
- Story: team gold lead with turning points, item timings marked elite / on time / late, everyone's economy.

## Chat translation (in game)
- Spots chat in other languages; **Ctrl/⌘+Shift+T** opens the Chat corner with the whole match, translated through your Puter account, and keeps translating new lines while open.
- Reply in your language: it's translated into theirs and copied for you to paste. The app never types into Dota. **Ctrl/⌘+Shift+O** goes back to the overlay.
- A phrase dictionary remembers short phrases (and your corrections), so repeats like "gg" or "спасибо" cost no AI call. Edit it in Live Coach → Overlay setup.

## Fewer repeated reminders
- Coach tips repeat at most every 3 game minutes and 3 times a match; stack/pull alerts are for supports only.

## Also
- Header navigation no longer cuts off tabs on narrower windows; faster startup (main bundle 575 kB → 233 kB).
- After updating, restart Dota once so the game feed includes chat.
